Good Bar to have some good music
Feb 2026 • Friends
I will give Acoustics Bar a “ 4 “ 
Acoustic bar in Ho Chi Minh City is pretty interesting as you walk in the narrow alley. They lead you to 2 of their location. 
One where you have a mix of Vietnamese - English singers and the other one for English songs, the sitting arrangement is pretty good no obstructions all area have a good view of the band and Singers performing. 
They have wide range of drinks options .. prices wise ok for this kind of set up and the number of singers alternating one another so you have continuous songs.
Will definitely visit again .. the band/singers start around 09:30pm

A Gem down the end of A Dark Ally
Apr 2023
This is the one thing you must do in Saigon, I found this place after reading reviews from trip advisor, and it is so good, really entertaining and gives you such a great look into the life of Vietnam. The music starts at 9 and people get up and sing with a really talented live band, each act do 4 or 5 numbers. The place i snot large so get in early before hand to ensure you get a seat. Beer prices wow steep, but I suppose they need to make money somehow, but 160,000 vnd for a Tiger Beer. Saying that I would definately go again, it was so much fun and really enjoyed the night out
